coordinator.task: Coordinate source-grounded findings and integration; consume upstream refs.

reader-ui.task: Investigate browser/UI behavior and publish a versioned report.

reader-api.task: Investigate API/data behavior and publish a versioned report.

writer.task: Consume accepted report/proposal, implement within the active lease.

verifier.task: Independently reproduce or validate candidate revision.

reviewer.task: Review remaining semantics after mechanical checks pass.

single: One Run owns the same functional work and may use the same public tools; no distinct-Run collaboration credit is required for this ablation. Independent external scoring remains identical.
serial: Same six-role template as parallel, overlapping Reader execution disabled; all roles count against the same aggregate trial budget.
parallel: Same six-role template as serial, Reader concurrency enabled; same-checkout Writer remains serial.
